specific_diseases_listed: Cataract, Glaucoma and other disorders of lens, disorders of Retina
Pancreatitis and Stones in Biliary and Urinary System
Abnormal Utero-vaginal bleeding, female genital Prolapse, Endometriosis/Adenomyosis, Fibroids, PCOD, Hysterectomy
All internal or external benign or In Situ Neoplasms/Tumors, Cyst, Sinus, Polyp, Nodules, Swelling, Mass or Lump
Hyperplasia of Prostate, Hydrocele, Varicocele and spermatocele
Hemorrhoids, Fissure or Fistula or Abscess of anal and rectal region, Pilonidal Sinus & Rectal Prolapse
Osteoarthritis, Rheumatoid Arthritis, Gout, Intervertebral Disc disorders, Joint Replacement Surgeries
Disease of middle ear and mastoid, Tonsils and Adenoids, Nasal Septum and Nasal Sinuses/Polyp
Gastritis, Gastroesophageal Reflux Disorder, Ulcer, Erosion and Varices of Upper Gastrointestinal Tract

inpatient_hospitalization.notes: Includes room rent, ICU/CCU/HDU, OT, doctor fees, medicines, diagnostics, prosthetics implanted internally during surgery

domiciliary_treatment.notes: Covered if domiciliary hospitalization continues for at least 3 consecutive days

ayush_coverage.notes: In-patient AYUSH treatment at recognised AYUSH hospitals/day care centres (Ayurveda, Yoga, Naturopathy, Unani, Siddha, Homeopathy)

organ_donor_expenses.notes: In-patient hospitalization expenses for organ donor for harvesting, subject to Transplantation of Human Organs Act 1994

ambulance_cover.notes: Road ambulance to hospital/day care centre; limit per policy schedule

preventive_health_checkup.limit_text: Optional benefit; covers 12 specified tests (CBC, ESR, HbA1C, Sr Creatinine, Lipid profile, RUA, SGOT/SGPT, GGT, Uric Acid) for insured above 18 years
preventive_health_checkup.notes: Reimbursable up to Rs 900 if network not available

maternity_coverage.notes: Excluded under Excl18 except ectopic pregnancy

modern_treatments.notes: Includes Uterine Artery Embolization, HIFU, Balloon Sinuplasty, Deep Brain Stimulation, Oral chemotherapy, Immunotherapy, Intravitreal injections, Robotic surgeries, Stereotactic radiosurgeries, Bronchial Thermoplasty, Stem cell therapy (hematopoietic for BMT), IONM

restoration_benefit.notes: Available for related and unrelated conditions per schedule; not triggered for first claim of policy year

worldwide_emergency_cover.notes: Worldwide in-patient hospitalization is an optional basic benefit (3.3.1)

permanent_exclusions: Rest cure, rehabilitation and respite care
Obesity / weight control surgery not meeting BMI criteria
Breach of law with criminal intent
Treatments at health hydros, nature cure clinics, spas
Sterility and infertility (IVF, ZIFT, GIFT, ICSI, surrogacy)
War, nuclear, radiological, chemical, biological events
Treatment outside India (unless worldwide benefit opted)
notable_exclusions_summary: Standard IRDAI exclusions plus permanent exclusions for adventure sports, treatment outside India (unless worldwide benefit opted), external congenital anomalies, OPD (unless add-on opted), maternity (except ectopic). Some Set-1 exclusions can be waived if 'All medically necessary hospitalization' option is opted.
available_riders: Reduction in specific illness waiting period (Comprehensive / Essential)
claim_process_summary: Two modes: cashless at network hospitals (planned: notify 3 days before admission; emergency: notify within 48 hours) and reimbursement (submit claim within 15 days of discharge). Pre-authorization required for cashless. Settlement within 15 days of complete documentation; 2% above bank rate penal interest on delay.
